verses.text: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

segments.text: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!

verses.text: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.

segments.text: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.

verses.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!

segments.text: Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!

verses.text: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.

segments.text: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.

verses.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

segments.text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

verses.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.

segments.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests; Samuel was among those who called on His name. They called to the LORD and He answered.

verses.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.

segments.text: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.

verses.text: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.

segments.text: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.

verses.text: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.

segments.text: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
